entities.summary: Meshullam ben Menahem of Volterra, also known as Meshullam da Volterra, was an Italian Jewish businessman who traveled to the Holy Land and surrounding Jewish communities. His works provide concise and important details about the nature and conditions of Ottoman Jewry.
